title: Ya Rab Na Ho Is Shab ki Saher
body:
Kehtey hai haram sab roo roo ker....ya rab na ho is shab ki saher
Kal din me bapa hoga mehshar....ya rab na ho is shab ki saher
1. Kal aoun o mohd jayeinge aur khoon me nahaker aayeinge
Kal layeinge do lashe Sarwar....ya rab na ho is shab ki saher
<<DIVIDER>>
2. Kal hogi kuch aisi shadi kuch dair me hogi barbadi
Dulhan royegi dulha par....ya rab na ho is shab ki saher
<<DIVIDER>>
3. Laila ko bada shadma hoga dil tukhde hoga Zainab ka
Kal layeingey sheh lashe akber....ya rab na ho is shab ki saher
<<DIVIDER>>
4. Woh zulm kareinge kal aada ek teer chalega sheh shoba
Zakhmi hoga halq e asgher....ya rab na ho is shab ki saher
<<DIVIDER>>
5. Hamsheer yeh manzer dekhegi sajde me karinge zulm shaqi
Shabbir ka kat jayega sar....ya rab na ho is shab ki saher
<<DIVIDER>>
6. Aayegi qayamat kal hum per lut jayega sab dadi ka ghar
Karti hai dua sheh ki duqtar....ya rab na ho is shab ki saher
<<DIVIDER>>
7. Kal sham e gharibaa aayegi har sar se chader jayegi
Hoyenge haram sab nange sar....ya rab na ho is shab ki saher
<<DIVIDER>>
8. Abbas na honge jab jouhar kuch aur hi hoga kal manzer
Kal Zainab hogi pehrey par....ya rab na ho is shab ki saher
Azz...Jawad Ali jouhar
